user.title: Set up your Casambi network
user.description: Find the bluetooth MAC address (network ID) in the luminaire details of your Casambi app.

data_description.address: Bluetooth MAC address of the Casambi network, e.g. AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.
data_description.password: Password of the Casambi network, not of your Casambi account.
data_description.import_groups: Create light and number entities for the groups of the network.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Set up {name}
bluetooth_confirm.description: A Casambi network was discovered. Enter its password to set it up.

data_description.password: Password of the Casambi network, not of your Casambi account.
data_description.import_groups: Create light entities for the groups of the network.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate {name}
reauth_confirm.description: The password of the Casambi network {name} was rejected. Enter the current network password.

data_description.password: Password of the Casambi network, not of your Casambi account.

reconfigure.title: Change the password of {name}
reconfigure.description: Enter the new password of the Casambi network {name}.

data_description.password: Password of the Casambi network, not of your Casambi account.

error.invalid_address: The bluetooth MAC address of the network is invalid.
error.rate_limited: The Casambi cloud temporarily refuses new logins. Wait a few minutes and try again.
error.cloud_unreachable: The Casambi cloud is not reachable, so the password can't be verified. Check the internet connection and try again.

abort.bluetooth_error: No connectable bluetooth adapter or proxy is available. Set up bluetooth in Home Assistant first.
abort.not_supported: The discovered device does not accept connections.

data_description.import_groups: Create light and number entities for the groups of the network. The integration reloads after a change.

network_not_found.message: The Casambi network {address} was not found. Make sure a bluetooth adapter or proxy is in range.

bluetooth_error.message: Bluetooth communication with the Casambi network {address} failed.

auth_failed.message: Authentication to the Casambi network {address} failed.

unexpected_error.message: Unexpected error while connecting to the Casambi network {address}.

write_failed.message: Sending the command to the Casambi network failed.

rate_limited.message: The Casambi cloud temporarily refuses new logins for the network {address}.

invalid_address.message: The stored bluetooth address {address} is invalid. Remove the network and add it again.

invalid_value.message: The value is not supported by the Casambi light.

cloud_unavailable.message: The Casambi cloud can't be used and the network {address} isn't cached yet. Check the internet connection.

unsupported_protocol.message: The protocol version of the Casambi network {address} isn't supported by this integration.

no_connectable_scanner.title: No bluetooth adapter for Casambi
no_connectable_scanner.description: The Casambi network {address} can't be reached because Home Assistant has no bluetooth adapter or proxy that supports connections. Add a local bluetooth adapter or an active bluetooth proxy. The integration connects automatically once one is available.
